units.rawText: This is just who I am... I'm a terrible liar, and I can't really fool anyone.

units.rawText: Little by little though, I've come to understand my purpose. I'm not only here to protect people, but to help disperse the darkness in their hearts with the sun's warmth and my smile.

units.rawText: And you too, professor. If there's anything you're worried about, I'm all ears!
